title: 基本的な例
分類子の宣言
uml:
@startuml
actor User
participant Browser
participant Server
database Database

User -> Browser : Request
Browser -> Server : Send request
Server -> Database : Query
Database --> Server : Result
Server --> Browser : Response
Browser --> User : Display
@enduml

title: 矢印の見た目を変える
uml:
@startuml
Alice -> Bob : normal
Alice --> Bob : dotted
Alice ->> Bob : thin arrow
Alice -[#red]> Bob : red arrow
Alice -[#blue,dashed]> Bob : blue dashed arrow
@enduml

title: すべての分類子にまたがるノート
uml:
@startuml
participant Alice
participant Bob
participant Charlie

Alice -> Bob : Hello
Bob -> Charlie : Request

note across
This note spans across all participants.
end note

Charlie --> Bob : Response
Bob --> Alice : Done
@enduml

title: ライフラインの活性化
uml:
@startuml
autoactivate on
alice -> bob : hello
bob -> bob : self call
bill -> bob #005500 : hello from thread 2
bob -> george ** : create
return done in thread 2
return rc
bob -> george !! : delete
return success
@enduml
